_README: Hand-authored news items for the Live Wire ticker. The ticker ALSO auto-includes commitments and top summer-league performances (factual, derived from data) — these hand-authored items layer on top, newest-first by date. Add items with: node scripts/add-news.mjs "<headline>" [--prospect <id>] [--url <url>]. Each item: { headline, prospectId (optional → links to profile), url (optional → external link), date }.

items.headline: Welcome to Prospera Preps — DMV summer-league stats now live across 60 teams
